 Living Our Values
 With a vision rooted in the wellbeing and inclusive engagement of our team members, our customers, their end users and our communities, people are the heart of what we do and who we are. Our values unite and guide us in everything that we do.
Our values include: Growing our People, Building Belonging, Innovating Responsibly, Delivering Excellence and Creating Customer Success.
As part of our team, you’ll do impactful work within an inclusive environment where everyone works together to achieve extraordinary outcomes. You’ll be empowered to reach your full potential through managing your own personalised development plan and access to our learning and development programs.
Plexus is seeking a Cybersecurity Ops Analyst I to join our Global Technology team. In this role, you will be responsible for the daily monitoring and response to cybersecurity events, maintaining security tools, and handling customer support requests. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to detect, triage, and resolve security incidents while ensuring compliance with security baselines, policies, and procedures.
 Key Responsibilities
Incident Response & Event Monitoring: Triage, investigate, and analyze security alerts from global ticketing systems and security tools. Escalate security incidents as needed following standard incident response protocols.
Cross-Functional Collaboration & Support: Partner with internal teams to investigate and resolve cybersecurity incidents and customer requests, adhering to Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
Data Loss Prevention (DLP) & Phishing Review: Support DLP initiatives including data monitoring and investigations. Review phishing email submissions and investigate removable media usage to evaluate business needs and mitigate risk.
Tool Administration: Assist in managing cybersecurity tools, including anti-virus/malware, secure file sharing, endpoint encryption, email security, and DLP software.
Security Posture & Best Practices: Maintain knowledge of current threat trends, frameworks, and regulations. Assist in developing, updating, and enforcing security policies, knowledge base articles, and procedures.
 Qualifications & Requirements
 Education & Experience
Education: Bachelor’s degree with 1+ years of related experience preferred (or an equivalent combination of education and experience).
Help Desk / Support: Prior experience in technical support or help desk roles is preferred, ideally within a manufacturing environment.
 Technical & Professional Skills
Security Tools: Exposure to DLP, Anti-Virus, SIEM, EDR, Vulnerability Scanners, or related cybersecurity tools is a plus.
System & Network Fundamentals:
Basic understanding of Active Directory and Windows/Linux system administration.
Basic understanding of network services, devices, the OSI model, and TCP/IP protocols.
Core Principles: Ability to comprehend fundamental cybersecurity concepts (e.g., defense-in-depth) and apply them practically.
 Working Conditions & Travel
Environment: Professional office setting involving standard desk and computer usage.
Travel: None required (N/A).
